groups.name: Display
groups.note: Barlow Condensed: signage for headings and big figures. Uppercase for display and headline only.

styles.name: display
styles.sample: BILL EVERY JOB. KNOW EVERY MARGIN.

styles.name: headline
styles.usage: Website and support-site section headings, uppercase.

styles.name: title
styles.usage: Page titles in the app and help articles, sentence case.

styles.name: figure
styles.usage: The headline number in a stat card or corner frame.

groups.name: Text
groups.note: Atkinson Hyperlegible Next: designed so I, l and 1, and O and 0, never look alike.

styles.name: body-lg

styles.name: label
styles.usage: Eyebrows, table headers and stat labels, uppercase.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Location codes, order and shipment numbers, SKUs and barcodes in running text and tables.

styles.name: scan-code

tokens.usage: Badges and the WMS tag.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Buttons, inputs and checkboxes.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Cards, panels and dialogs. The mark tile is 9/48 of its size, so a 48px tile has 9px corners.

shadow.note: Lines first; shadows only for things that float.

tokens.name: shadow-sm
tokens.usage: Cards at rest, when a line is not enough.

tokens.name: shadow-lg
tokens.usage: Menus, popovers and dialogs.

tokens.name: focus-ring
tokens.usage: Keyboard focus on every control: light, a 2px ink ring then 2px of floor yellow (the ink ring carries the contrast); dark, a 2px floor ring.
